subject: grimoire
reason: The installed measurement rubric cannot represent instrumented metrics whose run results were not audited. Assigning zero would assert unmeasured content; a baseline-only grade would overstate whole-unit coverage.
scope: Checked-in source, synthetic fixtures and the stored embedding ranking only; no live provider, private-library, device or new eval experiment.

rows.name: recorded_embedding_baseline_rankings
rows.importance_reason: Provides an informational, reproducible synthetic ranking baseline; it does not select a live embedding provider.
rows.formula: mean recall@k (k=1,3,5,10); reciprocal rank limited to the stored depth-10 ranking
rows.limit: The checked-in ranking answers every labelled query using known document ids. Recall and MRR were recomputed from this stored artifact without executing a provider or generating new rankings.

rows.name: live_embedding_quality
rows.formula: paired recall@k and MRR on the labelled corpus
rows.limit: The stored bag-of-words ranking is a harness baseline. No live-model ranking was included; its quality remains unaudited.

rows.name: parser_compatibility_outcomes
rows.importance_reason: The offline decide gate guards migration of recorded reply shapes.
rows.limit: The labelled gate records are present. This overview did not rerun the gate or treat the presence of its fixtures as an observed current aggregate.

rows.name: continuity_lexical_admission
rows.importance_reason: Informs token and character candidate floors.
rows.formula: positive admission recall; admitted-pair precision; crowd top-k retention
rows.limit: The checked-in behavioral test asserts alone recall 4/28 and precision 4/9, and shared-cast recall 21/28 and precision 21/31. These are source reference expectations, not a new execution result.

rows.name: continuity_semantic_admission
rows.limit: The lexical corpus explicitly leaves cosine absent. Semantic-floor quality requires model observations that were outside this audit.

rows.name: packed_history_retrieval
rows.importance_reason: Compares retrieval signals on the evidence actually packed into the prompt.
rows.limit: No aggregate run result was included in the checked-in evidence selected for this audit. Instrumentation and synthetic fixtures exist; this is not a claim that the metric has never run. History macro recall includes an empty-gold closed-branch control as 1; this denominator must be distinguished from positive-evidence retrieval recall.

rows.name: history_planning_adoption
rows.importance_reason: Changing the automatic planning default requires a recall gain and an explicit cost bound.
rows.formula: paired recall@3 improvement; false triggers; per-planned-turn money
rows.limit: The source gate refuses an absent cost bound and unpriced planning calls. No live adoption table or agreed cost bound was included.

rows.name: epistemic_prompt_leakage
rows.importance_reason: Informs whether planted secrets cross a reader-specific prompt boundary.
rows.formula: forbidden token exposure and allowed-token recall
rows.limit: No aggregate run result was included in the checked-in evidence selected for this audit. Instrumentation and synthetic fixtures exist; this is not a claim that the metric has never run.

rows.name: epistemic_live_reply_leakage
rows.importance_reason: The live gate requires clean exposed replies and successful judge coverage.
rows.formula: token leakage plus closed-decision judge over exposed replies
rows.limit: No exposed live replies or calibrated judge outcomes were included. The source distinguishes unjudged/failed judgments from clean ones; it does not establish the judge’s agreement with human truth.

rows.name: investigation_correctness_and_leakage
rows.importance_reason: Adopting the investigation arm requires a live margin, paired sign test and non-worsening leakage.
rows.formula: correctness difference; sign test; text and selection leakage
rows.limit: The source explicitly says canned offline tools prove the loop and graders rather than model quality. No live comparison table was selected.

rows.name: optional_prose_style_compliance
rows.importance_reason: Provides informational checks for an optional prescriptive prose style.
rows.formula: sentence/paragraph variation and lexical construction checks
rows.limit: These detectors express optional style-rule compliance using declared structural heuristics. Human writing quality is a different construct; missing human labels are not a defect in the rule-compliance instrument.

rows.name: eval_cost_latency_and_token_completeness
rows.importance_reason: Informs cost and latency tradeoffs between configurations.
rows.formula: per-case wall time and separate billed/equivalent/modelled costs
rows.limit: No saved run aggregates were selected. A confirmed accounting exception remains: history planning drops missing token components before dividing by all turns, so its displayed tokens/turn can be an unmarked lower bound.

rows.name: synthetic_compiled_cache_benchmarks
rows.limit: Synthetic endpoint timings and counters support cache-adoption decisions. No benchmark output or speed claim was audited, and no benchmark was executed.

rows.name: synthetic_membership_cost_gate
rows.limit: The instrument compares capture/derive/index costs on throwaway synthetic inputs. Saved results and the adoption decision were not audited.

rows.name: backend_session_performance_budget
rows.limit: The instrument compares compatible session profiles using a five-run median, plus manifest and skip checks. Its current performance conclusions were not audited.

rows.name: backend_phase_timing
rows.limit: Opt-in pytest phase, fixture, wall-time and operation measurements exist. Current profile outputs were not audited; instrumentation presence is not a validated performance result.

findings.title: History-planning tokens per turn can hide partial reporting
findings.detail: A turn with unknown planner counts and known check counts yields a numeric tokens/turn value: _per_turn removes None components then divides by every row. The summary prints that value without a count-completeness marker. No model experiment was needed to establish this statement order.
findings.blast_radius: Token comparisons used while reviewing planning overhead

not_audited: Live providers, live run files and private libraries were outside the selected repository-only audit scope.
No new experiment or evaluation suite was run. The recorded embedding baseline was analysed as stored data.
This is an ungraded inventory of the selected measurement evidence, not a test pass rate, runtime-correctness score or claim that instrumentation is absent.
Operational telemetry and performance profiles without selected run artifacts were not evaluated for production distributions.
refresh_notes: Stored corpus sizes and embedding ranking scores were re-derived from checked-in data. No evaluation or provider experiment was run.
The history-planning aggregation refactor preserves the partial-token accounting issue; its definition and summary citations were refreshed.

Package measurement pages with no local measurement definitions remain ungraded. Root, evals, scripts and backend-tests coverage grades remain omitted because results-not-audited is not a status supported by the installed rubric.

credited.detail: The split-cache fallback returns null if any tier is unknown; its final filtered sum does not silently discard missing tiers.

credited.practice: Latency summary reports the contributing denominator
credited.detail: The pre-generation latency median and maximum state how many timed runs contributed, and an empty set is rendered as n/a.

credited.practice: Live epistemic gate requires successful judging of exposed replies
credited.detail: The gate requires answered, clean replies and a clean judge verdict for live exposed content; failed or unjudged results cannot stand in for a passing judgment.

discovery_limits: Root-level find_metrics, count_examples and find_fail_soft scripts were run; their textual results are leads, not findings. Formula and consumer review confirmed the retained partial-token-accounting finding.

The dataset scanner cannot recognize all project-specific nested labels and encounters deliberately malformed provider-reply fixtures. Corpus sizes in this report were therefore derived directly from their owning data structures rather than copied from the scanner headline.
